messages:
Maya Patel: quick async update — throughput gating for this sprint. PR #432 (kernel microbatch window) needs merge before we can toggle continuous batching on canary. blockers: failing perf regression on 512-token tails and one flaky CI test.
Tony Nguyen: which perf regression? saw a +6% p99 on nightly. is that the same?
Maya Patel: yep, p99 up on long sequences when kv-prefetch hits a cold path. reproducer in gist: https://git.internal/rw/repro-432 (logs attached).
Srujan Rao: I'm running the reproducer now. early note: eviction pressure spikes when batch size oscillates. looks related to the new kv-ttl heuristics.
Emily Carter: small FYI — platform/runtime driver 2.7.1 landed in staging today; if kernel relies on the older driver we should pin.
Ryan Li: suggested temporary mitigation: reduce max_batch_size from 64 -> 32 and set prefix_cache.enabled = true. that'll lower pressure while we fix the eviction logic.
Tony Nguyen: can we A/B that in canary? I can flip config on 3 nodes and run loadgen.
Maya Patel: please do. make the change via the rollout api:
```
POST /v1/rollouts
{
  "canary_nodes": 3,
  "overrides": {
    "runtime.max_batch_size": 32,
    "runtime.prefix_cache.enabled": true
  }
}
```
Srujan Rao: testing note: I saw a repro where the kv cache metrics jump: `kv.evictions_per_min` spikes to ~120 when the sequence tail is >400. adding this query to the grafana panel helps: `sum(rate(kv_evictions_total[1m])) by (instance)`
deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled by Tony Nguyen for 2026-03-18T17:00:00Z — ID rdo-roll-6123 :information_source:
Emily Carter: ownership clarifications — Maya + Srujan on kernel patch, Tony on canary rollout, Ryan on config mitigation, I'll own platform pin and QA.
Maya Patel: timeline proposal: merge PR by EOD tomorrow, CI flake triage today, Srujan finishes validation by tomorrow morning, Tony runs canary afternoon. if canary looks good we flip continuous-batching on Friday.
Tony Nguyen: I'll post results in this thread once loadgen finishes. quick ping to @engineering-oncall if anything spikes.
Ryan Li: small perf patch I pushed to the branch to reduce mutex contention. PR #436 — low-risk, can be hotfixed into canary if needed.
Srujan Rao: ran 10k reqs with reduced batch size — p99 down ~3.8% and kv.evictions_per_min stable. attaching short log: `kernel: processed 10k reqs, avg latency 42ms`
Maya Patel: ok good progress. next steps: 1) Srujan final validation, 2) Tony canary rollout, 3) merge #432 if green, 4) follow-up issue for kv-ttl tuning (assign Srujan). I've created the issue: https://git.internal/rw/issues/2891 :thumbsup:
Tony Nguyen: ack, will update here.
Maya Patel: thanks all — keeping this async so folks can pick up. if anything blocks immediate deploy, @here please escalate.
